summary: I recommend a pass. The change adds docs/spec.toml, which covers BRIEF.md "Project Olympus" sections 1 to 6, and a checking test in xtask/tests/spec.rs. Each requirement in the spec has an id, a plain statement, a kind, a status, and verbatim quotes with headings, and duplicates are merged into one requirement with several sources. The spec records no open questions and gives its reason; the file format and the test still support open questions. In the snapshot, I ran `cargo test -p xtask --test spec`: all 12 tests passed, including the real-spec check, four negative cases (bad quote, duplicate id, missing supersedes target, requirement with no source) and the coverage check for sections 1 to 5 and R1 to R8. The policy tests passed, and `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -D warnings` were clean. The full `cargo test` has one failure in athena-data. Athena reports it also failed on the base commit, and this change does not touch that crate. CHANGELOG.md, decision D111, enforcement row M33 and the ontology entry are updated as planned. One minor gap: the checker confirms a quote is somewhere in BRIEF.md but not that it sits under the heading it cites.
